QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] General's Pet
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Blundell, general of Kritias.
QuestInfo.1: Blundell wants you to chat with the townsfolk. Start with #bBeatrice#k, the professor at Kritias's magic college.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Beatrice. What secrets will she reveal?

1.0: Excuse me, but I'm quite busy at the moment. These invisible fairy-glyphs won't enspellify themselves, you know!

npc.0: #bBeatrice#k is probably near the academy building. Such a magical lady! The Ranheim Academy is the shiny building to the right of town.

item.0: Blundell might have sent you. Then again, you might be an inverted doppelganger here to steal my soul's wallet! Do you have anything to prove I can trust you?
